string-array.name: cues_two_hand_swing
string-array.item: Hinge at the hips, not the knees, and hike the bell back high between your legs
Snap the hips forward and squeeze the glutes; the arms only guide it
Let it float to chest height, then hinge as it falls

string-array.name: cues_one_hand_swing
string-array.item: Hike the bell back with one hand, the other arm free
Snap the hips and keep the shoulder packed down
Stay square: don’t let the bell twist your torso

string-array.name: cues_clean
string-array.item: Keep the bell close and let it travel up the body, not around it
Drive with the hips and tame the arc so the bell rolls softly onto the forearm
Finish in the rack: wrist straight, elbow tucked to the ribs

string-array.name: cues_press
string-array.item: Start from a tight rack, glutes and abs braced
Press up and slightly out, the forearm vertical under the bell
Lock out with the biceps by the ear, then pull it back down to the rack

string-array.name: cues_snatch
string-array.item: Swing it back high, then drive the hips and pull the elbow back
Punch the hand through at the top so the bell lands without a bang
Lock out overhead and pause before the drop

string-array.name: cues_get_up
string-array.item: Keep your eyes on the bell and the arm locked the whole way
Roll to the elbow, then the hand, and bridge the hips high
Sweep the leg through to a kneel, then stand; reverse each step back down

string-array.name: cues_goblet_squat
string-array.item: Hold the bell by the horns at your chest, elbows down
Sit between your heels with the chest up
Push the knees out and drive up through the whole foot

string-array.name: cues_row
string-array.item: Brace a hand on a bench with a flat back
Pull the elbow back towards the hip, not up to the shoulder
Lower under control to a long arm

string-array.name: cues_jerk
string-array.item: Dip a short way with the knees, heels down
Drive up hard and drop under the bell to lock the arm
Stand tall before you bring it back to the rack

string-array.name: cues_long_cycle
string-array.item: Clean the bell to the rack, then jerk it overhead
Drop it back to the rack, then into the next swing
Breathe with each phase and keep a steady pace

string-array.name: cues_halo
string-array.item: Hold the bell upside down by the horns at your chest
Circle it close around your head, elbows tight
Keep the ribs down and switch direction each round

string-array.name: cues_front_squat
string-array.item: Rack the bell, wrist straight and elbow tucked
Sit straight down with the chest up
Drive up and stand fully tall

string-array.name: cues_armor_building_complex
string-array.item: Two cleans, a press and three front squats make one rep
Keep the bells tight to the body on every clean
Rest with the bells in the rack rather than on the floor

string-array.name: cues_deadlift
string-array.item: Bell between your feet, hinge with a flat back
Push the floor away and stand tall
Lower it the way it came up, hips back first

string-array.name: cues_high_pull
string-array.item: Swing the bell back, then drive the hips
Pull the elbow high and back, the bell close to the body
Let it fall back into the swing

string-array.name: cues_racked_lunge
string-array.item: Hold the bell in the rack on one side
Step back and lower the back knee towards the floor
Drive through the front foot to stand

string-array.name: cues_windmill
string-array.item: Press the bell up, eyes on it, feet turned away
Push the hip out and slide the free hand down the front leg
Keep the top arm locked, then rise slowly

string-array.name: cues_bottoms_up_press
string-array.item: Hold the bell upside down, the grip crushing the handle
Keep the wrist straight and the forearm vertical
Press slowly; a wobble means slow down, not push harder

string-array.name: cues_iron_cardio
string-array.item: A clean, a press and a squat make one rep
Keep the bell in the rack for the squat
Breathe at the top of each rep and find a steady pace

string-array.name: cues_barbell_snatch
string-array.item: Start with a wide grip and the hips higher than the knees
Push the floor away, then extend hard through hips and knees
Pull yourself under and catch it locked overhead in a squat

string-array.name: cues_barbell_clean_and_jerk
string-array.item: Clean the bar to the shoulders and stand up out of the squat
Dip and drive, then split under the bar to lock it out
Step the front foot back, then the back foot forward

string-array.name: cues_barbell_clean
string-array.item: Keep the bar close as it passes the knees
Extend hard, then pull yourself under
Catch it on the shoulders, elbows high, and stand

string-array.name: cues_barbell_jerk
string-array.item: Dip straight down with the bar on the shoulders
Drive up and split the feet as you punch under
Recover the front foot first, then the back

string-array.name: cues_barbell_power_snatch
string-array.item: Snatch grip, the bar close to the shins
Extend hard and pull the bar high
Catch it overhead above a quarter squat

string-array.name: cues_barbell_power_clean
string-array.item: Start with the bar over the middle of the foot
Extend hard through hips and knees
Catch it on the shoulders above a quarter squat

string-array.name: cues_barbell_hang_snatch
string-array.item: Stand with the bar, then slide it to just above the knees
Jump hard from the hips and pull under
Catch it overhead and stand

string-array.name: cues_barbell_hang_clean
string-array.item: Start standing, the bar lowered to just above the knees
Drive from the hips and shrug
Catch it on the shoulders and stand

string-array.name: cues_barbell_snatch_pull
string-array.item: Snatch grip, set the back flat
Pull as for a snatch, finishing tall with a shrug
Keep the arms long; this is the pull without the catch

string-array.name: cues_barbell_clean_pull
string-array.item: Clean grip, set the back flat
Pull as for a clean, finishing tall with a shrug
Keep the arms long; the bar stays close

string-array.name: cues_barbell_overhead_squat
string-array.item: Lock the bar overhead with a wide grip
Squat down with the bar over the middle of the foot
Push up into the bar as you stand

string-array.name: cues_barbell_snatch_balance
string-array.item: Bar on the back, snatch grip
Dip, then drive yourself down under the bar fast
Catch in a full squat with the arms locked, then stand

string-array.name: cues_barbell_push_press
string-array.item: Bar in the front rack, elbows a little forward
Dip a short way, then drive with the legs
Press it the rest of the way and lock out over the head

string-array.name: cues_barbell_back_squat
string-array.item: Bar on the upper back, hands tight
Brace, then sit down between the heels
Keep the knees over the toes and drive up

string-array.name: cues_barbell_front_squat
string-array.item: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high
Sit straight down with the chest up
Drive the elbows up as you stand

string-array.name: cues_barbell_deadlift
string-array.item: Bar over the middle of the foot, shins close
Brace, take the slack out of the bar, then push the floor away
Stand tall, then lower it hips back first

string-array.name: cues_barbell_romanian_deadlift
string-array.item: Start standing, knees soft
Push the hips back and slide the bar down the thighs
Stop when the hamstrings stretch, then drive the hips forward

string-array.name: cues_barbell_bench_press
string-array.item: Eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched
Lower the bar to the lower chest, elbows under the bar
Press up and slightly back

string-array.name: cues_barbell_overhead_press
string-array.item: Bar on the front of the shoulders, grip just outside them
Squeeze the glutes and press straight up past the face
Push the head through once the bar clears it

string-array.name: cues_barbell_row
string-array.item: Hinge forward with a flat back
Pull the bar to the lower ribs
Lower it under control without standing up

string-array.name: cues_push_up
string-array.item: Hands under the shoulders, body in one line
Lower the chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees
Push the floor away to the top

string-array.name: cues_incline_push_up
string-array.item: Hands on a bench or a wall, body in one line
Lower the chest to the edge
The lower the surface, the harder it is

string-array.name: cues_pike_push_up
string-array.item: Hips high, the body in an upside-down V
Lower the top of the head towards the floor between the hands
Press back up to the pike

string-array.name: cues_bench_dip
string-array.item: Hands on the bench edge, fingers forward
Lower until the elbows reach about 90 degrees
Keep the shoulders down and press back up

string-array.name: cues_pull_up
string-array.item: Hang with the hands just wider than the shoulders, palms away
Pull the elbows down to the ribs until the chin clears the bar
Lower all the way to straight arms

string-array.name: cues_chin_up
string-array.item: Hang with the palms facing you, shoulder width
Pull the chest towards the bar
Lower all the way down

string-array.name: cues_inverted_row
string-array.item: Hang under a bar or a table with the body straight
Pull the chest up to the bar
The more upright you are, the easier it is

string-array.name: cues_air_squat
string-array.item: Feet shoulder width, arms forward
Sit the hips back and down, chest up
Stand all the way up

string-array.name: cues_split_squat
string-array.item: Stand in a long stride
Drop the back knee straight down towards the floor
Drive up through the front heel

string-array.name: cues_reverse_lunge
string-array.item: Step back into a long stride
Lower the back knee towards the floor
Push through the front foot to step back up

string-array.name: cues_bulgarian_split_squat
string-array.item: Rest the back foot on a bench
Lower straight down over the front foot
Drive up through the front heel

string-array.name: cues_step_up
string-array.item: Put the whole foot on the box
Drive up through that heel, not the back foot
Step down slowly

string-array.name: cues_glute_bridge
string-array.item: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
Drive the hips up and squeeze the glutes
Keep the ribs down; don’t arch the lower back

string-array.name: cues_single_leg_glute_bridge
string-array.item: One foot down, the other leg up
Drive the hips up level
Lower slowly without twisting

string-array.name: cues_wall_sit
string-array.item: Back flat on the wall
Slide down until the thighs are level with the floor
Knees over the ankles, and breathe

string-array.name: cues_calf_raise
string-array.item: Stand on the balls of the feet, on a step if you have one
Rise as high as you can
Lower slowly below level

string-array.name: cues_plank
string-array.item: Forearms under the shoulders
Body in one line from head to heels
Squeeze the glutes and brace

string-array.name: cues_side_plank
string-array.item: Elbow under the shoulder, feet stacked
Lift the hips into one line
Don’t let the hips sag or rotate

string-array.name: cues_hollow_hold
string-array.item: Lie on your back and press the lower back into the floor
Lift the shoulders and legs a little off the floor
Arms overhead makes it harder, by your sides easier

string-array.name: cues_dead_bug
string-array.item: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over the hips
Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly
Keep the lower back on the floor

string-array.name: cues_burpee
string-array.item: Squat, hands down, and jump the feet back to a plank
Lower the chest, then push up
Jump the feet in and jump up tall

string-array.name: cues_mountain_climber
string-array.item: Start in a high plank
Drive one knee towards the chest, then switch
Keep the hips level and the shoulders over the hands

string-array.name: cues_band_pull_apart
string-array.item: Hold the band at shoulder height, arms straight
Pull it apart until it touches the chest
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly

string-array.name: cues_band_face_pull
string-array.item: Anchor the band at face height
Pull towards the eyes, elbows high and wide
Finish with the hands beside the ears

string-array.name: cues_band_seated_row
string-array.item: Sit with the band around the feet or an anchor
Pull the elbows back past the ribs
Sit tall; don’t lean back

string-array.name: cues_band_lat_pulldown
string-array.item: Anchor the band high
Pull the elbows down towards the hips
Keep the chest up and the shoulders down

string-array.name: cues_band_chest_press
string-array.item: Anchor the band behind you at chest height
Press forward until the arms are straight
Return slowly to the chest

string-array.name: cues_band_overhead_press
string-array.item: Stand on the band, hands at the shoulders
Press straight up overhead
Lower slowly back to the shoulders

string-array.name: cues_band_biceps_curl
string-array.item: Stand on the band, palms forward
Curl the hands towards the shoulders
Keep the elbows by the sides

string-array.name: cues_band_triceps_pushdown
string-array.item: Anchor the band high
Push down until the arms are straight
Keep the elbows pinned to the sides

string-array.name: cues_band_pallof_press
string-array.item: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side on to it
Press the hands straight out from the chest
Resist the pull: don’t rotate

string-array.name: cues_band_woodchop
string-array.item: Anchor the band high on one side
Pull it across and down to the opposite hip
Turn through the hips and the trunk together

string-array.name: cues_band_squat
string-array.item: Stand on the band, the ends at the shoulders
Sit down between the heels
Drive up against the band

string-array.name: cues_band_good_morning
string-array.item: Stand on the band, the loop behind the neck
Hinge forward with a flat back
Drive the hips forward to stand

string-array.name: cues_band_glute_bridge
string-array.item: Band just above the knees
Push the knees out against it
Drive the hips up and squeeze

string-array.name: cues_band_lateral_walk
string-array.item: Band around the legs above the knees or ankles
Half squat, then step sideways
Keep tension on the band the whole time

string-array.name: cues_band_clamshell
string-array.item: Lie on your side, band above the knees, knees bent
Open the top knee, feet together
Don’t let the hips roll back

string-array.name: cues_hundred
string-array.item: Lift the head and shoulders, legs up or in a tabletop
Pump the arms by the sides
Breathe in for five pumps and out for five

string-array.name: cues_roll_up
string-array.item: Lie long with the arms overhead
Peel up through the spine a bone at a time
Roll back down the same way

string-array.name: cues_single_leg_circles
string-array.item: One leg up to the ceiling, the other long
Circle the leg, keeping the pelvis still
Reverse the direction, then switch legs

string-array.name: cues_rolling_like_a_ball
string-array.item: Balance just behind the sit bones, knees hugged in
Roll back to the shoulder blades
Roll up to balance without the feet touching down

string-array.name: cues_single_leg_stretch
string-array.item: Head and shoulders lifted
Hug one knee in and stretch the other leg out
Switch with control

string-array.name: cues_double_leg_stretch
string-array.item: Hug both knees with the head up
Stretch the arms and legs out long
Circle the arms back and hug in again

string-array.name: cues_scissors
string-array.item: Both legs up, the head and shoulders lifted
Lower one leg as you pull the other towards you
Switch with two pulses

string-array.name: cues_criss_cross
string-array.item: Hands behind the head, the shoulders lifted
Turn an elbow towards the opposite knee
Switch sides slowly

string-array.name: cues_spine_stretch_forward
string-array.item: Sit tall, legs apart and feet flexed
Round forward through the spine, reaching ahead
Stack back up to sitting

string-array.name: cues_saw
string-array.item: Sit tall with the arms out to the sides
Twist, then reach the hand past the opposite foot
Return to centre and switch

string-array.name: cues_swan
string-array.item: Lie face down, hands under the shoulders
Lift the chest by lengthening the spine
Lower slowly

string-array.name: cues_single_leg_kick
string-array.item: Lie on the forearms with the chest lifted
Kick one heel towards the glutes twice
Switch legs

string-array.name: cues_side_kick_series
string-array.item: Lie on your side, legs slightly forward
Swing the top leg forward and back
Keep the hips stacked and the trunk still

string-array.name: cues_teaser
string-array.item: Lie down, then roll up to balance in a V
Reach the arms towards the feet
Roll back down with control

string-array.name: cues_swimming
string-array.item: Lie face down with the arms and legs long
Lift them and flutter opposite arm and leg
Keep the neck long and the eyes down

string-array.name: cues_shoulder_bridge
string-array.item: Bridge the hips up, feet flat
Lift one leg and lower it, the hips level
Switch legs

string-array.name: cues_seal
string-array.item: Sit balanced, the hands holding the ankles from inside
Clap the feet three times, then roll back
Roll up and clap again

string-array.name: cues_leg_pull_front
string-array.item: Start in a high plank
Lift one leg without the hips shifting
Lower it and switch
